Agent Model

Better name: bayesian_agent? -Could initialize with an SCM that represents the agent’s internal representation of the world. -Class could store the trace and perhaps using this model the predictions based on the SCM. -This would make the class contain both the agent’s beliefs and thought processes (how to update beliefs based on new data).

The Bayesian models specified here correspond to how an ideal Bayesian agent would update his beliefs given that he sees one or several observations and receives their predictions that are based on an OLS regression model without intercept.

The agent is considered to have a separate SCM which uses the agent’s (prior or posterior) beliefs to choose the best treatment for a patient.

Technically only one value of X should be allowed after update. -Is there any point of allowing for sampling for other X-values? -The model is NOT VALID for other X values. -Don’t block this (yet), because that would prevent updating with e.g. 100 patients’ info.

Could be interesting to estimate variance for CATE using sampling as we should expect correlation between E(Y|X,do(A1)) and E(Y|X,do(A0)) but do not know how large that is. This applies to both prior and posterior.

class agent_model.AgentModel(plate_size, prior_parameters=None, scm_constants=None, predictive_var_names=None, low_dim_aux_plate=True, test=False)

Bases: object

Class for agent models with structural equations:

\(Y_i = a + b X_i + N_{E} A_i + N_{Yi}\)

\(A_i = d X_i + N_{Ai}\)

\(X_i = N_{Xi}\)

where N_{Xi}, N_{Ai}, N_{Yi} are normal noise variables drawn J times for every instantiation of the plate and N_{E} is a normal variable drawn once per instantiation of the plate.

Parameters:

  • plate_size (int) – size of the plate (number of i.i.d. samples).

  • scm_constants (dict) – dictionary with structural equation scm_constants ‘a’, ‘b’, and ‘d’. If scm_constants is None, then it defaults to values in the paper (28.8.2025).

  • prior_parameters (dict) – dictionary with parameters for prior distributions If prior_parameters is None, then it defaults to values in the paper (28.8.2025).

  • low_dim_aux_plate (bool) – If true the plate is estimated using low-dimensional auxiliary variables. This speeds up inference. If false, the plate is explicitly modeled.

  • test (bool) – If true, the model is set up in testing mode enabling multiple observed data points to be input. This is mainly for testing that the model works as intended.

Returns:

None

get_prior_CATE_mu(A1_treatment, A0_treatment)

The method returns the mean of the CATE-distribution times A1_treatment - A0_treatment. The current SCM is such that N_E is not dependent on X and the treatment effect only depends on N_E and size of A_treatment.

Parameters:

  • A1_treatment (float) – Dosage value of higher dose treatment

  • A0_treatment (float) – Dosage value of lower dose treatment

sample_posterior_do_A(X, A_treatment, rng=None)

Method for estimating the outcome for a patient with features X based on the agent’s posterior beliefs. Draws one potential outcome for every draw in trace.

Parameters:

  • X (np.array) – Feature to condition on

  • A_treatment (float) – Fixed treatment value

  • rng (int or rng) – Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

sample_posterior_predictive(rng=None)

This method generates a sample from the agent’s posterior beliefs. Using the trace stored in self, this method replaces the parameter values in self.predictive_scm and draws a posterior predictive sample from this.

Parameters:

rng (int or rng) – Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

Notes: Consider VECTORIZING this method.

sample_posterior_predictive_CATE(X, A1_treatment, A0_treatment, rng=None)

This method returns a sample from the posterior predictive CATE-distribution, and its sample mean and standard deviation.

  • A1_treatment (float) – Higher dose treatment value

  • A0_treatment (float) – Lower dose treatment value

  • rng (int or rng) – Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

sample_prior_predictive(draws=1000, rng=None)

Method for sampling from distribution based on the agent’s prior beliefs.

Parameters:

  • draws (int) – Size of sample to draw

  • rng (int) – Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

sample_prior_predictive_CATE(X, A1_treatment, A0_treatment, rng=None)

This method returns a sample from the prior CATE-distribution, and its sample mean and standard deviation. Currently CATE is not dependent on X and is hence ATE. It also does not require conditioning on X.

Parameters:

  • A1_treatment (float) – Dosage value of higher dose treatment

  • A0_treatment (float) – Dosage value of lower dose treatment

  • X (np.array) – Feature to condition on.

  • rng – seed or initialized random number generator for reproducibility

sample_prior_predictive_summaries(rng=None)

Method that estimates mean, variance, skewness, and kurtosis of the variables X, A, and Y in the prior samples.

Parameters:

  • rng (int or rng) – Seed or initialized random number generator for

  • earlier. (reproducibility. Used only if prior samples were not drawn)

save_agent_model(file_name='agent_model', folder='./saved_models/')

Save the entire agent model (trace + configuration).

  • folder (str) – Folder to save models into.
